name: Chevron
description: Chevron is a vertically integrated oil and gas company. Upstream finds and produces crude oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids (3.7 million barrels of oil-equivalent per day in 2025, up about 12 percent on 2024 after the July 2025 Hess acquisition; proved reserves 10.6 billion BOE). Downstream refines crude into fuels, lubricants and chemicals and sells them through about 8,600 US and 5,200 international branded stations plus commercial customers. Upstream earns most of the profit, but Downstream books most of the reported sales because it resells crude and products at market prices, so earnings swing with oil and gas prices (Upstream earnings fell from $18.6B in 2024 to $12.8B in 2025).

employees.note: Total employees per the 10-K table (12,438 US, 30,013 international, 588 other); 37,860 are non-service-station employees.

businessLines.name: Upstream
businessLines.how: Sells crude oil, natural gas and NGLs it produces, at prevailing market prices, so revenue and earnings move with commodity prices and volumes; also earns from equity affiliates such as Tengizchevroil (50 percent owned) and LNG projects. Sales are after eliminating intersegment transfers to Downstream.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment earnings (net income attributable to Chevron)

businessLines.name: Downstream
businessLines.how: Buys crude and feedstock, refines it and sells gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, lubricants, additives and petrochemicals wholesale and through branded stations (Chevron, Texaco, Caltex); profit is the margin between product prices and crude cost, so high revenue but thin earnings.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment earnings (net income attributable to Chevron)

brands.name: Chevron / Texaco (US stations)
brands.note: About 8,600 branded service stations at year-end 2025, about 380 company-owned or leased

brands.name: Chevron / Texaco (Latin America) and Caltex (Asia-Pacific)
brands.note: About 5,200 branded stations outside the US including affiliates

brands.name: Hess Corporation
brands.note: Acquisition completed July 2025; Guyana assets came with it; Upstream earnings and 2025 reserve additions include Hess

brands.name: Chevron U.S.A. Inc.
brands.note: Runs most US businesses; FY2025 sales $142,048M (77 percent of consolidated 184,432, computed), net income $5,197M
